# bobbyhadz

> > A comprehensive tech blog and learning resource by Borislav Hadzhiev covering cloud computing, serverless architecture, React.js, and web development best practices.

bobbyhadz is a technical blog and educational platform focused on modern web development, AWS cloud services, and programming fundamentals. The site features in-depth articles, tutorials, and the author's book "All in Programming" designed to help developers become more efficient and skilled.

## Key Topics

- AWS
- Serverless
- React.js
- Node.js
- Web Development
- Cloud Computing
- CDK
- Code Optimization
- Software Development
- Programming Fundamentals
- Problem Solving
- Career Development
- Open Source
- Learning Resources

## Core Content

- [Blog | bobbyhadz](https://bobbyhadz.com): Homepage featuring articles on AWS, Serverless, React.js and web development
- ["All in Programming" by Borislav Hadzhiev | bobbyhadz](https://bobbyhadz.com/blog/all-in-programming): Programming book by Borislav Hadzhiev on becoming a better, efficient programmer

## About & Author

- [About Me | bobbyhadz](https://bobbyhadz.com/about): Author bio for Borislav Hadzhiev covering AWS, Serverless, React.js expertise
